title: CSNP, CryptoScan repository and README

title: Semgrep, Community Edition
supports: Source-rule engine, JSON/SARIF outputs; engine capability is distinct from any particular custom rule set.

title: Semgrep 1.181.0, LGPL 2.1 license
supports: Pinned engine license; not a license to reuse every vendor-maintained rule.

title: Semgrep, Rules License version 1.0
supports: Internal-business-use limitation and restrictions on distributing or providing these rules as a service; use original project rules or separately authorized rule packs.

title: Where's Crypto, implementation README
supports: IDA proof-of-concept; tested dependency versions include IDA SDK 7.2 and Qt 5.6.3. Current-version compatibility and redistribution rights remain unestablished.

title: C. Meijer, V. Moonsamy, and J. Wetzels, Where's Crypto, USENIX Security 2021, pp. 555-572
supports: Binary cryptographic primitive classification using data-flow analysis and symbolic execution; does not establish application-level migration roles.

title: L. Piccolboni et al., CRYLOGGER implementation README
supports: Instrumented Android crypto API logs; tested Android 9 and Ubuntu 18.04 environment. Not a generic Python/Go runtime tracer.

title: CRYLOGGER MIT License
supports: MIT license text for repository code; external Android and other dependencies require their own review.

title: IBM, Guardium Cryptography Manager
supports: Vendor-documented discovery/inventory, dependency/ownership/usage mapping and lifecycle capabilities; related Quantum Safe Explorer and Remediator. No comparative accuracy asserted.

title: SandboxAQ, AQtive Guard inventory documentation
supports: Inventory includes cryptographic operations, keys, certificates and related assets; operation context is not unique to PQMigrate.

title: Keyfactor, cryptographic discovery and inventory
supports: AgileSec inventory with usage, ownership, dependencies and risk context; vendor-described scope only.

title: QuSecure, cryptographic discovery and inventory
supports: Continuous inventory and operational rollout context; vendor claims do not establish comparative precision or market share.

title: UK NCSC, Timelines for migration to post-quantum cryptography
supports: Recommended UK milestones: discovery and planning by 2028, highest-priority migration by 2031, migration completion by 2035; not a universal legal mandate.

title: European Commission, Coordinated implementation roadmap for the transition to PQC
supports: EU-coordinated migration planning is a demand signal, not proof of customer purchasing intent.

title: GitHub Docs, Licensing a repository
supports: Public source visibility is distinct from permission to reproduce, redistribute or make derivative works.

title: NIST NCCoE, Migration to Post-Quantum Cryptography
supports: Separate cryptographic discovery and interoperability workstreams; supports need for both inventory and validation, not a product endorsement.

title: PQMigrate, pinned unscored Semgrep baseline, revision 72dc7445c531bae2a54e488a5a97cf14c141bf90
supports: Rules, runner, source-only manifests and raw archives; 72 synthetic snippets and 119 pinned files were run unscored. Not evidence of accuracy or multi-engine integration.
